research.role: Graduate Researcher · Powered Prosthesis Team · Dr. Aaron Young
highlights: Support powered-prosthesis trials through motion-capture and onboard sensor data collection.
Integrate and configure BLDC actuators and IMUs for the OSL powered prosthesis using Jetson Orin Nano.
Integrated a hardware emergency stop and tested the circuit at various currents using an ESP32 C++ script.
Developed a thermoregulated bath for in situ testing and confocal microscopy of biological specimens.
Designed parts and drawings for machining and 3D printing in SolidWorks, and selected thermal materials for lab safety and fixture effectiveness.
Designed and fabricated a modular fixture and test method for component-level friction testing across da Vinci Multiport Core 8 mm instruments.
Conducted CT scanning and material testing to compare metal 3D-printed and metal injection-molded patient-contacting components.
Designed and assembled safety cladding and fixturing for force-feedback test equipment.
Led customer collaboration to diagnose EFEM vibrations using three-axis accelerometer data and Python spectral analysis, presenting findings to technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
Performed static and dynamic load calculations and FEA for robot redesign configurations using simplified CAD models, Creo, and Python.
Designed a fixture to run 24-hour motor tests on multiple units without full assembly.
Designed, prototyped, and built a fixture in SolidWorks to improve warehouse safety and ergonomics.
Collaborated on a da Vinci 5 surgeon-side console motor test module, refining designs with FEA, 3D printing, and drawings including GD&T.
Designed, prototyped, released, and qualified manufacturing and inspection fixtures using SolidWorks and Bambu Lab and Phrozen 3D printers.
Developed and improved radial-force and tensile tests for incoming inspection using Mark-10 test stands, MSI radial-force testing, Excel, and Python.
Analyzed product-return data to streamline Operations solutions using QAD, Rhino3D, and Excel.
Conducted design-of-experiments and feasibility testing on new tubing material using Minitab, Geomagic, and ScanApp.
